title: After Fifteen
description: The timer adds a layer of difficulty to progression - when it runs out, radiation will cover the entire surface for a long time, disrupting any surface-level development.
body:
# AfterFifteen - Nuclear Apocalypse Survival

**AfterFifteen** is a hardcore survival mod that adds a personalized radiation system for each player. Every player has their own timer, their own radiation level, and their own consequences.

## 🌍 The Cycle

The mod works in a three-phase cycle for each player independently:

### ⏰ Phase 1: PROTECTION (Default: 15 minutes)
After first join, you have **15 minutes** to prepare. Gather resources, build a shelter, or dig deep. The countdown has begun...

### ☢️ Phase 2: RADIATION (Dimension dependent)
- **Overworld:** 7 days
- **Nether:** 21 days  
- **End:** 28 days

During this phase, the surface is contaminated! You'll accumulate radiation based on your height:
- **Above 64 blocks:** ×2.0 radiation (MOST DANGEROUS)
- **51-64 blocks:** ×1.5 radiation (DANGEROUS)
- **Below 50 blocks:** SAFE ZONE (no radiation)

### ⏳ Phase 3: IDLE
After radiation ends, you enter an idle phase. No timers, no radiation - just hallucinations from what you've experienced...

## 🩻 Radiation Sickness (10 stages)

As your radiation level increases, you'll experience worsening effects:

| Stage | Radiation | Effects |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| 1 | 5-14% | Nausea, Weakness I |
| 2 | 15-24% | Weakness II, Hunger I |
| 3 | 25-34% | Slowness I, Hunger II |
| 4 | 35-44% | Mining Fatigue I, Slowness II |
| 5 | 45-54% | Blindness, 1.0❤️ damage |
| 6 | 55-64% | Poison I, 1.5❤️ damage |
| 7 | 65-74% | Unluck, 2.0❤️ damage |
| 8 | 75-84% | Wither I, 2.5❤️ damage |
| 9 | 85-94% | Darkness, 3.0❤️ damage |
| 10 | 95%+ | DEATH APPROACHING! 4.0❤️ damage |

## 👻 Hallucinations

When radiation drops to zero, you'll experience **2 hours of hallucinations**:
- Fake mob sounds (zombies, skeletons, creepers)
- Herobrine sightings
- Explosion sounds
- Item pickup/drop sounds
- Chat messages from "unknown players"
- Random slot swapping
- And much more...

## 🎮 Commands

(Global command - in development, use {Nickname})

### Player Commands (`/af`)
- `/af status [player]` - Check your (or another player's) radiation status
  - Shows current phase
  - Time remaining
  - Accumulation rate per second
  - Current location

### Admin Commands (`/afc`)

#### Global Settings
- `/afc set protected global <time>` - Set default protection time
- `/afc set radiation global <time>` - Set default radiation time for all dimensions
- `/afc set multiplier accumulation global <value>` - Set global accumulation rate
- `/afc set multiplier decay global <value>` - Set global decay rate
- `/afc set dimension overworld/nether/end <time>` - Set radiation time per dimension

#### Player-specific Settings
- `/afc set protected <player> <time>` - Set protection time for specific player
- `/afc set radiation <player> <time>` - Set radiation time for specific player  
- `/afc set multiplier accumulation <player> <value>` - Personal accumulation multiplier
- `/afc set multiplier decay <player> <value>` - Personal decay multiplier

#### Information Commands
- `/afc get protected [global/player]` - Get protection time
- `/afc get radiation [global/player]` - Get radiation time
- `/afc get multiplier accumulation [global/player]` - Get accumulation multiplier
- `/afc get multiplier decay [global/player]` - Get decay multiplier
- `/afc get dimension overworld/nether/end` - Get dimension radiation times

#### Reset Commands
- `/afc reset player <player>` - Reset player to global defaults
- `/afc reset all` - Reset ALL online players

### Settings Commands (`/afsettings`)
- `/afsettings notifications on/off` - Toggle chat notifications
- `/afsettings status` - Check your current settings

## ⚙️ Configuration

All values can be changed in-game via commands or in the config file:
- Protection time
- Radiation time per dimension
- Accumulation/decay multipliers
- Hallucination settings

## 🌟 Features

✅ **Per-player timers** - Each player has their own independent cycle  
✅ **Persistent data** - Progress saves when you log out  
✅ **Multiplier system** - Personal and global multipliers  
✅ **Height-based radiation** - Go deep to stay safe!  
✅ **10-stage sickness system** - Increasingly dangerous effects  
✅ **Hallucinations** - Psychological horror after radiation exposure  
✅ **Fully localized** - English and Russian supported  
✅ **Admin friendly** - Full command control  
✅ **Lightweight** - No performance impact

## 📥 Installation

1. Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1
2. Download the mod
3. Place in `.minecraft/mods` folder
4. Launch the game!

## 📝 Notes

- Timers only run when you're online
- Data saves when you log out
- You can customize everything via commands
- Safe zone is Y-level 50 and below
- Hallucinations can be disabled in config
